title: Face-on oriented self-assembled molecules with enhanced π–π stacking for highly efficient inverted perovskite solar cells on rough FTO substrates
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05849F, Paper
Jiajun Du, Jinling Chen, Beilin Ouyang, Anxin Sun, Congcong Tian, Rongshan Zhuang, Chen Chen, Shuo Liu, Qianwen Chen, Ziyi Li, Xiling Wu, Jingyu Cai, Yuyang Zhao, Ran Li, Teng Xue, Tiantian Cen, Kaibo Zhao, Chun-Chao Chen
4PABCz molecules with asymmetric structures form dense coverage on FTO substrates owing to their robust multilayered structure with strong intermolecular π–π stacking and face-on configuration for efficient charge transport.
